actions.label: BIN / ELF loaders
requirements: Start the matching console loader first. Select a compatible BIN or ELF and confirm its firmware/game requirements.

actions.label: WebKitty ELF loader · BIN
requirements: PS4 14.02 entry; the pinned WebKitty catalogue lists ELF Loader for 4.71–latest. Native bytes are unchanged; console execution remains untested.
Enable the HEN BIN loader on HTTP 9090 before sending the flat BIN. ELF traffic then uses its separate service on 9021.
Do not send an ELF to an older KARO raw BIN listener on 9021.
